name: Museumsnacht Innsbruck
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Once a year, the museums in Innsbruck open their doors for a long night filled with art, history, and culture. With a wristband, you can visit all participating venues—from the Alpenverein Museum to the Zeughaus and the Hofkirche. Everywhere, there are special guided tours, workshops, and live music.
